label: TP
reason: User input from request parameter 'BlCurated00003' flows directly into variable 'bar'. The code replaces " with ", which is HTML entity encoding sufficient to prevent script execution within the attribute context of the div tag ('...'). Since the encoded value is written into the HTML structure without further filtering, this constitutes a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User param replaced with " and injected into HTML attribute
